5 - Mega-mzephyr: 
M + Zeta = Mega
Delta + Mega = Megadelta
M + Zephyr = Mzephyr
Megadelta + Mzephyr = Mega-Mzephyr
Mega + Mega-Mzephyr = Mega-mzephyr
 ...
M + Zeta = Mega
Mega + Zeta = Megazord
M + Zephyr = Mzephyr
Megazord + Mzephyr = Mega-Mzephyr
Mega + Mega-Mzephyr = Mega-mzephyr

5 - M2wzeta: 
M + Water = MW
M + MW = M2
M2 + MW = M2w
M2w + Zeta = M2wZeta
M2 + M2wZeta = M2wzeta
